customerFacingReactions.label: Interesting, But I'm Not Sure
customerFacingReactions.meaning: Keep it in play and help me understand or test it.

customerFacingReactions.label: I Like Parts of This
customerFacingReactions.meaning: Capture which elements attract me and redesign around them.

customerFacingReactions.label: Not For Me
customerFacingReactions.meaning: Ask why and reduce similar possibilities.

customerFacingReactions.label: Absolutely Not
customerFacingReactions.meaning: Treat the stated reason as important evidence; do not assume the title alone is the problem.

customerFacingReactions.label: This Gives Me Another Idea
customerFacingReactions.meaning: Capture and analyze the customer's own possibility.

customerFacingReactions.label: I Already Considered This
customerFacingReactions.meaning: Ask what happened, what was attractive and what stopped it.

customerFacingReactions.label: Show Me What This Actually Looks Like
customerFacingReactions.meaning: Expand work reality, typical week, buyers/employers, economics and first steps.

principles: Never defend a recommendation merely because the matcher ranked it highly.
Separate rejection of a title from rejection of its underlying attributes.
One negative reaction must not automatically become a permanent hard constraint.
Customer agency overrides ranking; matching is exploration support, not prescription.
